title: What Chun-Li did after Bison fell in Street Fighter
subject: chunli
description:
Did Chun-Li deserve the final blow? 👇

Chun-Li's last stand against Shadaloo in Street Fighter V, and the girl she brought home. Spoilers for Street Fighter V: A Shadow Falls and Street Fighter 6.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Chun-Li spent her whole career chasing one man.
When Bison returned in Street Fighter V, she faced him in New York. His Psycho Power dropped her, and Cammy pulled her out.
Inside the Shadaloo base, she used the control pieces to shut down the Black Moons.
In those corridors she met a frightened girl named Li-Fen.
The final blow on Bison came from Ryu, not from her.
She stopped to look at Bison's fallen cap, then got Li-Fen out of the burning base.
Today she teaches kung fu and raises Li-Fen as her own family.
